text:
Alex: Heads up — eu-west1 spot GPU pool is thrashing, ~15% of inference pods restarted in the last 8m. Tail latency for /v1/generate jumped 3-5x. Logs show a mix of `instance-preempted` and `network interface flapping`. Anyone on pager?
Mira: On it. Pulling kube events + gcloud instance preempt logs now. Can you paste the affected routes?
Alex: Mostly gen-critical and batch-rerank lanes. Routing fallback to mixed-pool started but we still see requests hitting nodes that are draining due to stale routing cache (KV TTL 60s).
Sam: Is this purely spot churn or is there an underlying network issue in the AZ?
Alex: It's both. Cloud provider shows intermittent NIC resets in a subset of spot VMs at 10:16–10:24. That triggered our eviction handler which caused mass reconnects and KV cache invalidations, amplifying the regen storm.
Jia: If we overflow to on-demand/dedicated, what's the cost hit if we keep it for 30m–1h? Need quick estimate before we flip heavy routing.
Sam: Quick back-of-envelope: +~40% token cost for affected endpoints while KV warms. If we scale dedicated by +4 GPUs in eu-west1, that covers throughput but will be a few hundred dollars/hr.
Mira: Running commands to confirm state:
```
kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | egrep "CrashLoop|Evicted|Terminating"
NODE	STATUS	RESTARTS
inf-worker-23	CrashLoopBackOff	3
inf-worker-47	Terminating	2

kubectl get nodes -l cloud.google.com/preemptible=true -o json | jq '.items|length'
# => 28 (down from 35)
```
Mira: Also seeing TTL misses in the kv-cache metrics: kv_prefix_miss_rate spiked to 0.38 at 10:18.
ops-bot: Alert: autoscaler-scale-out suggested 6 nodes; recommended to prefer on-demand for routes with tag `gen-critical`. (actionable)
Sam: Proposed mitigations (short term):
- Flip routing preference to prefer on-demand/dedicated for `gen-critical` for 15m.
- Scale dedicated pool +4 GPUs in eu-west1 immediately.
- Pause spot autoscaler from adding more preemptible instances until stable.
- Increase KV TTL to 120s temporarily to reduce thrash (tradeoff: slightly stale routing).
Jia: I can trigger the dedicated scale and add the cost estimate to the incident. Who will flip routing?
Alex: I'll flip routing. Mira, can you run the scale script? Sam, handle KG/TTL change?
Mira: Executing scale now:
```
./infra/scale-dedicated --region=eu-west1 --add-gpus=4 --commit
# output
Initiating allocation request -> request-id=alloc-1843210000-az1
ETA ~ 3m 30s
```
deploy-bot: allocation alloc-1843210000-az1 accepted, provisioning 4 GPUs (eu-west1). ETA 3m 12s.
Mira: Confirmed new nodes are Ready at 10:27. Nodes: inf-ded-101..104.
Alex: Flipping routing policy to prefer dedicated for gen-critical now.
```
# runtime-router update
runtime-router update --route="/v1/generate" --prefer-tier=dedicated --ttl=15s
# response: ok
```
Sam: Increasing KV TTL to 120s in runtime-config to prevent regen storm:
```
runtime-config set kv.ttl=120
# applied
```
Jia: Created incident ticket INC-184321: "eu-west1 spot+NIC flaps -> gen tail latency". Attached cost note: ~+$300–$600 for emergency dedicated scale for 30–60m. Linking to sales if customer-facing SLA exposed.
Alex: Observability: 95th latency back to baseline after new nodes and routing flip; 99th improved but still ~1.6x for ~10m while caches warm.
Mira: Logs show fewer `instance-preempted` errors post-scale. kv_prefix_miss_rate down to 0.05 after 10m.
Sam: FYI we'll want a short-term mitigation doc: 1) prefer dedicated for gen-critical routes, 2) temporary TTL bump, 3) pre-warm KV on new nodes to avoid regen spikes.
Jia: Adding cost/playbook to incident: automated policy to pre-allocate 2 warm on-demand GPUs when spot eviction rate > 10% for >5m. Needs product + finance signoff.
Alex: Agreed. Owners: Mira (incident lead + postmortem), Sam (runtime fixes + playbook), Jia (cost/ops + policy). I'll escalate to infra leadership if we see repeated flareups.
Mira: Marking thread — mitigation applied, monitoring in stable window. Will start postmortem draft in ~1h. :white_check_mark: 
Sam: Note for postmortem: include sample log snippet and the kubectl outputs.
Jia: Also add the cost delta and suggested threshold for automatic warm-on-demand.
Alex: Thanks all. Closing for now, keep monitoring. :eyes:
